page: Amazon Web Services r8gb.12xlarge is an arm64 memory-optimized cloud server powered by AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors operating at 2.8 GHz. Driven by the Nitro hypervisor, the platform provides 48 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, backed by 64 KB L1 data cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 36 MB L3 cache. It delivers 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes a high-capacity 100 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no bundled local storage disks and contains no GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage architectures.

Benchmark evaluations reveal exceptional throughput in data-heavy and memory-intensive operations. The instance achieved top-tier ratings in uncached large-block memory bandwidth, reaching 434.99 GB/sec read and 216.28 GB/sec write speeds, along with high results in PassMark memory scoring and database operations at 47,920.83 ops. Multi-core execution demonstrates robust scaling, as seen in Geekbench multi-core results of 23,666.0, Clang software compilation scores of 71,057.0, and multi-core stress-ng performance. Network-adjacent web serving throughput reached 99.24 GB/sec, while in-memory operations achieved 101.9 million Redis SET operations per second. Conversely, single-threaded processing and small-model LLM generation benchmarks position in the average mid-tier bracket.

From an efficiency perspective, the dedicated single-thread-per-core layout prevents resource contention across execution units, translating memory density into consistent parallel processing capability. The primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of local NVMe storage and hardware matrix accelerators, which concentrates performance strictly on network-delivered data and CPU-bound parallel tasks. Amazon Web Services r8gb.12xlarge is appropriate for in-memory caches, distributed databases, large-scale data analysis, multi-threaded build farms, and memory-constrained enterprise applications.
description: Amazon Web Services r8gb.12xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the Nitro hypervisor and powered by AWS 48-core ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors running at 2.8 GHz. Equipped with 48 dedicated physical cores with single threading, the instance provides 384 GB of system memory at an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. It features 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no integrated GPUs, and includes no local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached volumes. Benchmark evaluations reflect top-tier throughput in large-block memory read and write bandwidth, Clang compilation, and PassMark database operations, complemented by strong multi-threaded compression and Redis transaction rates. While single-thread instruction throughput remains average, the dedicated ARM core topology and high memory density deliver efficient multi-core parallel execution. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, Redis caches, high-throughput web serving, large-scale data processing pipelines, and enterprise memory-bound analytical applications.
